* **Location:** Bethesda, MD
* **Work Type:** On\-Site
* **Shift:** First

* **U.S. Citizenship Required?** Yes


**Position Summary**
--------------------


Base\-2 Solutions is seeking a DevOps Software Engineer to design, develop, and deploy a state\-of\-the\-art technology stack supporting the DOMEX Data Discovery Platform (D3P) Modernization program. The role supports the mission to centralize and standardize Tasking, Collection, Processing, Exploitation and Dissemination (TCPED) of Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) across the Defense Intelligence Enterprise (DIE). The engineer will work as part of a mission\-focused, solutions\-oriented, and adaptive team that values inclusion, innovation, collaboration, and professional development. Most work is conducted on\-site in Bethesda, MD, with a flexible schedule and occasional remote tasks.



**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

* Deploy, triage, and maintain a production big data pipeline using a microservice architecture running on Kubernetes, Elasticsearch backend, and Kafka messaging.
* Enhance and maintain CI/CD and DevOps scripts and processes including AI\-integrated solutions for failure analysis, security, and compliance to facilitate faster development, quicker error detection, and resilient deployments.
* Design, develop, and support scalable, redundant infrastructure including physical and virtualized environments.
* Configure Kubernetes continuous deployments using Helm, YAML, and ArgoCD.
* Collaborate with System Engineers to design solutions for new features and requirements.
* Provide technical input to systems engineering documentation and diagrams/models in coordination with systems engineering and architect teams.
* Participate in Agile release planning, scrum of scrums, bug triage, design sessions, and other meetings

jobs.title: Senior Snowflake Developer
jobs.description:

We are expanding our data engineering capabilities and are looking for a dedicated Senior Snowflake Developer to join our team. We do not need a high\-level architect to design our overarching data strategy, nor are we looking for a full\-stack application developer who occasionally pulls data from our warehouse.

Instead, we need a true Snowflake practitioner. We are looking for a strong executor who thrives on building robust data pipelines, optimizing complex queries, and leveraging Snowflake’s native features to move and transform data efficiently. You will work closely with our Data Architects and Data Science teams to turn blueprints into high\-performing, scalable reality.

**The Impact You Will Make**  
You will be the engine of our data team. By bringing deep, hands\-on Snowflake expertise to the table, you will:

* **Accelerate Delivery:** Turn architectural designs into production\-ready pipelines, dramatically reducing our time\-to\-insight.
* **Optimize Performance and Cost:** Ensure our Snowflake environment runs at peak efficiency by fine\-tuning virtual warehouses, optimizing micro\-partitions, and streamlining compute resources.
* **Elevate Our Data Infrastructure:** Transition us away from external processing bottlenecks by migrating complex transformations directly into Snowflake using its native capabilities.
* **Free Up Strategic Bandwidth:** By taking ownership of heavy\-duty building and execution, you will allow our architects to focus on long\-term strategy and system design.
